constraints.name: supplier_release_rows_commercial_v2_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (commercial_policy IS NULL AND stock_qty IS NULL AND order_multiple IS NULL AND valid_to IS NULL OR commercial_policy IS NOT NULL AND commercial_policy = 'supplier-price-commercial-fields-v2'::text AND (stock_qty IS NULL OR stock_qty >= 0) AND (order_multiple IS NULL OR order_multiple > 0) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR isfinite(valid_to) AND valid_to >= '0001-01-01'::date AND valid_to <= '9999-12-31'::date))

guard_triggers.name: source_compatibility_receipts_immutable
guard_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER source_compatibility_receipts_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON supplier_price_ingestion_internal.source_compatibility_receipts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION supplier_price_ingestion_internal.reject_source_compatibility_change()

guard_triggers.name: supplier_release_rows_commercial_policy_guard
guard_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER supplier_release_rows_commercial_policy_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF release_id, stock_qty, order_multiple, valid_to, valid_from, commercial_policy ON public.supplier_price_release_rows FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION supplier_price_ingestion_internal.guard_commercial_release_row()

advisors.rationale: New wrappers enforce actual auth.uid/current-profile organization and readonly data scope; no anon or PUBLIC execute. Private receipt RLS has no API-role policies or grants by design. Existing handoff FK/unused-index advisories were introduced before v2 and no indexes were removed.

result: PASS for independent SQL/schema/readers postapply scope
limits: No remote schema/data writes, leases, source uploads or publications were performed by this observer.
Clevite count and exact active pointer were verified; source values were compared on first and middle 5000-row pages, not all one million values.
Euroricambi source values and A10/B15/custom20 sales values were compared across all 542 rows; three atomic commercial-option samples also matched raw legacy terms.
No immediate full history hash existed before migration, so only known exact Mahle v1 receipt and Clevite publication identity preservation are claimed.
New v2 rows were zero at capture; full authenticated v6 upload/publication/download and actual deployed HTTP startup proofs remain separate.
This evidence does not verify production application or production behavior.
